COC7_HUD.wrongSystem: CoC7 HUD only works with the Call of Cthulhu 7th Edition system.
COC7_HUD.rollCheck: Roll a {label} check (Shift: skip the dialog)
COC7_HUD.dailySanity: Sanity lost today: {loss}. Losing {limit} or more in one day means indefinite insanity. Click to start a new day.
COC7_HUD.resetDailySanityBody: Set the sanity lost today back to 0 and the daily limit to one fifth of current Sanity?
COC7_HUD.sanLoss: Sanity loss for encountering it (success/failure). Click: Sanity check for the targeted tokens; Ctrl+click: post a check link to chat.
COC7_HUD.ammoTooltip: Rounds loaded. Click: +1, right-click: -1, Shift: reload fully or empty.
COC7_HUD.readiedGunTooltip: A readied firearm adds 50 to DEX for initiative (a bonus die with the optional initiative rule).

scale.name: HUD scale
scale.hint: Makes the whole HUD larger or smaller.

themeSource.name: Light or dark theme
themeSource.hint: The HUD is light or dark following one of Foundry's two color schemes (Configure Settings > Core > User Interface).

hideMacroBar.name: Hide the macro bar while the HUD is open
hideMacroBar.hint: The macro bar comes back when you hide the HUD.

alwaysHideMacroBar.name: Always hide the macro bar
alwaysHideMacroBar.hint: Hides Foundry's macro bar even while the HUD is hidden.

showForGM.name: Show the HUD for the Keeper
showForGM.hint: When off, a Keeper never sees the HUD, even with an investigator token selected.
